adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the refresh path now uses `parseRefreshTokenResponse(responseJson, refreshTokenResponseSchema)`. In sync mode (`APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT`), `parseRefreshTokenResponse` validates with `minimumTokenResponseSchema` and then forcibly sets `refreshTokenResponse.data.refresh_token = "refresh_token"` when absent. Office365 then merges tokens via `o365AuthCredentials = { ...o365AuthCredentials, ...(tokenResponse.success && tokenResponse.data) }`, which will overwrite the real stored `refresh_token` with the placeholder string whenever the sync endpoint doesn’t return a refresh token. That would break subsequent refreshes and can lead to perpetual refresh failure/loops. The specific claim about `expires_in` not advancing can’t be fully verified from the shown snippet, but the refresh_token overwrite is directly evidenced by the diff and is a correctness defect.
